lang.name: English
general.generateAtlases.desc: Pack UV islands into atlas textures, trim unused UV area and repack UVs. When off, textures are scaled as a whole without atlasing.
general.qualityPreset.desc: Target quality preset. Changing the preset updates all quality parameters below.
general.platformOverrideEnabled.desc: Override optimization parameters per platform (PC / Android / iOS).
general.whitelist.desc: Any objects here (meshes, materials, textures, animations, GameObjects...) are excluded from optimization. All textures referenced by them skip every optimization.
general.language.desc: Auto follows the NDMF language. Falls back to English when no translation exists.
general.verboseLogging.desc: Print detailed [ATO] logs (timings, sources, island counts, atlas sizes, utilization...).
general.npot.desc: Experimental NPOT sizes. Incompatible compression formats (e.g. PVRTC on iOS) are excluded automatically.
general.platform.desc: Each platform can override atlas size and per-category compression formats.
errors.invalidPlacement: ATO component is attached to '{0}' which does not have a VRCAvatarDescriptor. Attach the component to the avatar root object.
errors.multipleComponents: Multiple ATO components found under avatar '{0}'. Only one component per avatar is allowed.
errors.noComponent: No ATO component found. Add an 'Avatar Texture Optimizer' component to the avatar root object.
errors.prefab: Avatar contains prefab instances/assets which NDMF cannot process.
warnings.unpackableIsland: [{0}] UV island of '{1}' cannot fit into the largest atlas; skipped atlasing, scaled by quality instead.
warnings.oobRepeat: [{0}] Texture '{1}' has UVs that cross wrap seams or cannot be normalized; treated as whitelist.
warnings.animatedSt: [{0}] Texture '{1}' has animated or non-identity ST transform; treated as whitelist.
warnings.unknownShader: [{0}] Shader '{1}' is not fully analyzable; texture property '{2}' treated as whitelist.
warnings.grayscaleFallback: [{0}] Grayscale category set to single-channel format but texture '{1}' has multi-channel data; saved as multi-channel.
warnings.alphaFallback: [{0}] Texture '{1}' has alpha but format without alpha channel was selected; falling back to alpha-capable format.
warnings.npotFormat: [{0}] NPOT requested but format '{1}' requires POT on this platform; format adjusted.
warnings.decal: [{0}] Texture '{1}' is used as decal or with special sampling; treated as whitelist.
warnings.uvTransform: [{0}] Material '{1}' transforms texture '{2}' (offset/scale/rotation); treated as whitelist.
warnings.uvChannel: [{0}] UV channel {1} of '{2}' is used by non-mesh sampling; treated as whitelist.
warnings.noAao: Avatar Optimizer (AAO) is not installed; AAO UV compatibility skipped.
warnings.normalRetarget: [{0}] Normal map '{1}' was not repacked (tangent data preserved), atlas utilization may be lower.
report.title: AvatarTextureOptimizer build report
report.textures: Textures: {0} input, {1} after dedup, {2} optimized, {3} whitelisted
report.savings: Estimated VRAM savings: {0} MB -> {1} MB ({2}% reduction)
